description: Implementation of DocumentReadPlatformService for reading document data, files, and details from the database, including methods for retrieving all documents, specific document data, and file content, with internal mapping and exception handling.

classes.name: DocumentReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing document reading functionalities, including retrieving document lists, details, and file data, with internal mapping logic.

classes.name: DocumentMapper
classes.description: Internal RowMapper class for mapping SQL result set rows to DocumentData objects, with configurable hiding of location and storage type fields.

methods.name: retrieveAllDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves all documents for a given entity type and ID, after authenticating user.

methods.name: retrieveFileData
methods.description: Fetches file content for a specific document, handling not found exceptions.

methods.name: retrieveDocument
methods.description: Retrieves document metadata for a specific document ID, handling not found exceptions.

methods.name: fetchDocumentDetails
methods.description: Internal method to query and map document details from the database.
